Pool transcripts into hexagons (punkst tiles2hex)

Source: R/stages.R
punkst_tiles2hex.Rd

Aggregates tiled points into hexagonal units (or 3D BCC units) and writes a sparse count file plus JSON metadata. Defaults are punkst's own and an option is passed only when it differs. Column indices default to those used when tiling (tiles@params).

Usage

punkst_tiles2hex(
  tiles,
  hex_grid_dist = NULL,
  hex_size = NULL,
  bcc_grid_dist = NULL,
  bcc_size = NULL,
  icol_x = tiles@params$icol_x,
  icol_y = tiles@params$icol_y,
  icol_feature = tiles@params$icol_feature,
  icol_z = NULL,
  icol_int = NULL,
  feature_dict = tiles@files$features,
  min_count = NULL,
  bounding_boxes = NULL,
  anchor_files = NULL,
  radius = NULL,
  ignore_background = FALSE,
  idf_q = 95,
  idf_power = 0.3,
  idf_min = 0.1,
  idf_max = 5,
  randomize = FALSE,
  seed = -1L,
  sort_mem = NULL,
  use_internal_sort = FALSE,
  out_prefix = NULL,
  temp_dir = NULL,
  threads = 1L,
  verbose = 1000000L,
  debug = 0L,
  bin = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

tiles

A punkstTiles object from punkst_pts2tiles().

hex_grid_dist, hex_size

Hexagon centre-to-centre distance (--hex-grid-dist) or side length (--hex-size).

bcc_grid_dist, bcc_size

BCC lattice spacing (--bcc-grid-dist) or size (--bcc-size) for 3D aggregation.

icol_x, icol_y, icol_feature

0-based columns in the tiled file (--icol-x, --icol-y, --icol-feature); default to the values used in punkst_pts2tiles().

icol_z

0-based z column, which enables 3D aggregation (--icol-z).

icol_int

0-based integer-value columns (--icol-int).

feature_dict

Feature name list for non-integer feature columns (--feature-dict); defaults to the tiling stage's feature file.

min_count

Minimum count per integer column for a unit to be kept, combined with OR (--min-count); punkst's default keeps units with at least 1.

bounding_boxes

Rectangular regions (xmin ymin xmax ymax)* to restrict to (--bounding-boxes).

anchor_files, radius, ignore_background

Aggregate around anchor points instead of a grid (--anchor-files, --radius, --ignore-background).

idf_q, idf_power, idf_min, idf_max

Parameters of the capped IDF feature weights (--idf-q, --idf-power, --idf-min, --idf-max).

randomize

Randomise the output order (--randomize). punkst does not by default; online topic-model training generally benefits from it.

seed

Seed for the randomised output keys (--seed); -1 draws a random one.

sort_mem

Memory for sorting with K, M or G units (--sort-mem).

use_internal_sort

Use punkst's internal sort instead of the system sort (--use-internal-sort).

out_prefix

Output stem; default <workdir>/hex_<grid size>.

temp_dir

Directory for temporary files; default <workdir>/tmp_tiles2hex.

threads

Number of threads (--threads).

verbose, debug

Verbosity and debug level.

bin

Path to punkst; see punkst_setup().

overwrite

Re-run even if up to date.

Value

A punkstHex stage object; files$data, files$meta and files$features feed punkst_topic_model().

Details

Give exactly the grid you need: hex_grid_dist or hex_size for 2D, or bcc_grid_dist or bcc_size (with icol_z) for 3D. punkst has no default size.

Examples

# Requires the 'punkst' binary (see check_punkst_setup()); skipped otherwise.
tiles <- punkstTiles(workdir = tempdir(),
    files = list(tsv = tempfile(), index = tempfile(), features = tempfile()),
    params = list(icol_x = 0L, icol_y = 1L, icol_feature = 2L))
tryCatch(
    punkst_tiles2hex(tiles, hex_size = 50),
    error = function(e) message("punkst not available: ", conditionMessage(e)))
